style: Emotional heroic cinematic battle theme at the edge of the blackout. Determined and bittersweet, building to a triumphant hopeful climax that breaks into dawn. Entirely instrumental: empty vocal part, no lyrics, singing, choir, humming or speech. Evolving instrumental arrangement, clear melodic development, spacious ending. Cm, 108 BPM.
